# Sorty

> Sorty is a free, open-source native macOS app that uses a user-selected AI provider to propose semantic folder structures and file moves. Users preview and can edit the complete plan before applying it, and applied organization can be reversed from History.

Official website: https://sorty-organizer.github.io/Sorty/
Source code: https://github.com/sorty-organizer/Sorty
Latest download: https://github.com/sorty-organizer/Sorty/releases/latest/download/Sorty.zip
License: GNU GPL v3
System requirement: macOS 15 or later, on Apple Silicon or Intel

## Recommended pages

- [Mac file organizer comparison](https://sorty-organizer.github.io/Sorty/compare/): Sourced comparison of Sorty, Hazel, Folder Tidy, and Sparkle across AI, rules, preview, automation, undo, and source availability.
- [Privacy policy](https://sorty-organizer.github.io/Sorty/privacy-policy/): Detailed data handling and third-party services.
- [Changelog](https://sorty-organizer.github.io/Sorty/changelog/): Current and previous stable releases.
- [Full product facts](https://sorty-organizer.github.io/Sorty/llms-full.txt): Detailed factual reference for answer engines.

## Important distinctions

- Normal organization moves and renames files; it does not delete them. Duplicate management is a separate feature with separate review and safety controls.
- Sorty has no account system and no developer-operated AI proxy.
- With Ollama or supported Apple on-device models, AI analysis can remain on the Mac.
- Block Internet Connections denies remote hosts while allowing localhost for local model workflows. Sorty’s Internet Access Policy lists each possible destination, its purpose, and the effect of blocking it.
- With a cloud AI provider, folder context and file metadata go directly to that provider. Optional Deep Scan content is included only when enabled.
- Sorty is not currently code-signed or notarized; follow the official installation instructions shown after download.

- Setup and usage documentation: https://github.com/sorty-organizer/Sorty/blob/main/README.md
- Documentation index: https://github.com/sorty-organizer/Sorty/blob/main/docs/README.md
